# Solar Linear

Icons by **480 Design**: https://www.figma.com/community/file/1166831539721848736

Licensed under **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Source: https://github.com/iconify/icon-sets/tree/db4c0e1c75f933ae45c4484cd02ee3781a789363/json/solar.json

Only selected Linear icons are vendored, with the original 24×24 geometry and 1.5-unit strokes. `aliases.json` maps app functions to source glyphs. `scripts/generate_icons.py` converts SVG shapes and inherited presentation attributes into native Compose ImageVectors. Changes: conversion to native vector paths, currentColor tinting; no authored replacement geometry. Re-run the generator without a network connection.

Credit is also available in Settings → About TG Drive. The launcher logo is separate original TG Drive artwork.
